description: This file implements a handler for sending chat actions in Telegram via the grammy library, with automatic exponential backoff and circuit breaker logic to handle 401 Unauthorized errors. It manages retries, suspends operations after repeated failures, and provides reset functionality.

methods.name: createTelegramSendChatActionHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler for sending chat actions with automatic backoff and circuit breaker based on 401 errors.
